The Job in a Nutshell💡

We are looking for a skilled Accountant with a strong background in financial reporting, revenue recognition, and regulatory compliance, ideally within the SaaS and restaurant industries. The ideal candidate will have 4+ years of accounting experience, with a solid understanding of SaaS financial operations and hands-on experience managing accounting for restaurant businesses in Saudi Arabia. This role will also work closely with the Product team to test, validate, and enhance our ERP/Accounting product, ensuring it meets real-world accounting and operational requirements.

What Will You Do❓

Financial Reporting & Accounting Operations

  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance accounting efficiency and accuracy.
  • Contribute to the automation and optimization of financial processes.

9BDF0B39E6.description:
Who Are We❓

The Job in a Nutshell💡

You will construct agentic AI architecture, leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. Working within a compact engineering team, you will build the core foundational infrastructure, spanning microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and eval harnesses, ensuring systems are production-ready, reliable, and scalable.

This hands-on backend software engineering position focuses primarily on coding, testing, and system diagnostics. While prompt design is incorporated into the workflow, complex architectural challenges reside within the underlying infrastructure.

We welcome applicants across diverse seniority levels. Given that production-grade agentic engineering remains an emerging discipline, candidates bring varied expertise; candidate capability determines final level placement. Opportunities exist for early-career developers through veteran software architects.

Engineering excellence remains mandatory across all levels. Junior engineers pair directly with senior mentors to own production components within three months, while senior engineers drive technical standards and architectural vision.

What You Will Do ❓

  • Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces.
  • Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers featuring precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers.
  • Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards.
  • Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and systematically capture production edge cases.
  • Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency.
  • Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, RBAC permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers.
  • Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization.

What Are We Looking For❓

Essential

  • Deep software engineering expertise in a modern programming language, prioritizing algorithmic depth over superficial multi-language breadth.
  • Strong computer science foundations in data structures, algorithms, memory allocation, and concurrent execution patterns.
  • Practical experience with backend infrastructure: REST/gRPC APIs, relational/non-relational databases, caching tiers, message queues, and distributed systems resilience.
  • Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing clean, maintainable software.
  • Comprehensive mental model of LLM mechanics: context window constraints, tokenization, function calling protocols, non-deterministic behaviors, and hallucination management.
  • Demonstrated history of delivering full-lifecycle technical projects across production environments, academic work, open source, or side initiatives.
  • Methodical debugging skills with the ability to articulate systematic troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Strong technical documentation and written communication skills to articulate complex distributed system behaviors.

Expectations by Seniority Level

Core requirements apply universally, with ownership and operational scale adjusting based on candidate seniority.

  • Early Career: Focuses on technical foundations, algorithmic problem-solving, and curiosity. Prior agentic experience is not required; mentorship is provided to expand scope over well-defined modules.
  • Mid-Level: Owns sub-systems end-to-end, translates ambiguous requirements into robust architecture, and demonstrates a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production services.
  • Senior Level: Drives strategic architectural direction, possesses hands-on experience scaling non-deterministic systems, elevates team-wide engineering practices, and actively challenges technical assumptions.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience developing application prototypes integrated with LLM APIs.
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or custom tool integrations.
  • Understanding of vector database indexing, embedding generation, and retrieval pipelines (RAG).
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), telemetry, or IaC tooling.
  • Knowledge of GenAI security paradigms, prompt injection mitigation, and threat modeling.
  • Active open-source contributions or community engagement.

Out of Scope

  • Extensive experience with specific agent frameworks, given the nascent nature of the ecosystem.
  • Academic AI research background, specialized ML degrees, or mathematical derivation of backpropagation.
  • Deep expertise in base model training or fine-tuning workflows.
  • Flawless portfolio presentations; emphasis is placed on technical depth and problem-solving reasoning.
  • Strictly conventional career trajectories; non-traditional and self-taught engineering backgrounds are evaluated equally.

Technical Standards & Architecture

Our engineering environment adheres to industry standards and operational frameworks, with continuous learning embedded into the engineering onboarding process.

  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): Open standard managed via the Linux Foundation for integrating models with tool services and data stores.
  • OpenTelemetry GenAI Conventions: Standardized instrumentation schemas for tracking model execution traces, step transitions, and tool invocations.
  • OWASP GenAI & Agentic Security Guidelines: Threat modeling standards emphasizing containment strategies, least-privilege tooling, strict input sanitization, and authorization gates for critical actions.
  • Eval-Driven Development: Mandatory evaluation validation prior to shipping behavioral changes, relying on internal domain-specific test harnesses rather than external benchmark metrics.

What We Offer You❗

We believe you will love working at Foodics!

  • We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-office, and hybrid work setups.
  • We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
  • We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
  • Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
  • We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

The Job in a Nutshell💡

Foodics powers thousands of restaurants across the region — point of sale, payments, inventory, and the operational backbone underneath. We're building our own ERP platform: the system of record that sits under everything a merchant runs on Foodics.

This is an unusual EM role, so we'll be blunt about it. Today the team has three engineers and there is no team to manage. You will spend most of your time writing code — building the core platform and its integrations into inventory, payments and the POS, shoulder to shoulder with the other engineers.

What you're really being hired for is the second act. As the product matures into a real line of business at Foodics, you're the person who builds the team around it — hiring, structure, process, the whole thing. We want that team built by someone who wrote the first version of the system, not someone who inherited it.

If you're looking to step away from the keyboard, this isn't the role. If you want to build something from zero and then build the team that owns it, it is.

What Will You Do❓

  • Write production code as a core contributor, not as a manager who occasionally picks up a ticket
  • Own significant parts of the system end to end: core modules, the transactional foundation, regulatory compliance, integration surface
  • Make the architectural calls that determine whether this platform survives five years and be accountable for them
  • Set the engineering bar by example: code review standards, testing discipline, how we use AI tooling and where we don't trust it
  • Work directly with the PM and our domain experts to turn business requirements into a system
  • Own hiring: define the roles, run the loop, make the calls
  • Grow the engineers already here into people who can run pieces of this independently
  • Introduce process at the point it's needed and not before
  • Carry the product through its handover into the core business, with the team intact

Who Are We❓

The Job in a Nutshell💡

We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to sit between our customers and our product. You will embed with strategic merchants and partners, ship production code that solves their problems, and turn what you learn into reusable platform capabilities. 

Large chains and integration partners often need more than configuration: custom integrations, data flows and workflows that stretch the product. You own that work end to end, from the first discovery call to production rollout. This is a full-stack, customer facing engineering role. You write real code in our .NET microservices, Kafka-based event backbone and front-end apps, and you are measured on customer outcomes, not tickets closed. 

What Will You Do❓

Embed with customers 

  • Work directly with enterprise merchants, franchise groups and integration partners to understand their operations, systems and pain points. 
  • Run technical discovery: map their workflows, data and existing systems (ERP, delivery aggregators, loyalty, payment providers) against Foodics capabilities. 
  • Scope solutions, set clear expectations, and own delivery dates with the customer. Build and ship production software 
  • Design and build backend services and integrations in .NET (C#) following Clean Architecture and CQRS. 
  • Build event-driven flows on Kafka: producers, consumers, retries, dead-letter handling, idempotency and schema evolution. 
  • Use Redis for caching, rate limiting and short-lived state, with sound invalidation and TTL strategies. 
  • Build or extend front-end experiences (web apps, admin tools, mini-apps) when the solution needs a UI. 
  • Ship through CI/CD and own what you ship: observability in Datadog, alerts, runbooks and on-call for your deployments. 

Turn field work into product 

  • Spot patterns across customers and propose platform features instead of one-off forks. 
  • Write clear specs and handover docs so core teams can adopt and maintain what you built. 
  • Be the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions, backed by data on usage, impact and effort. 

Build the FDE motion 

  • Turn one-off deployments into repeatable playbooks, tooling, SDKs and reference integrations. 
  • Help define how FDE engagements are scoped and measured, and share learnings across Product, Engineering, Solutions and Customer Success.

What Are We Looking For❓

  • 6+ years building and running production software, including 3+ years on backend systems at scale. 
  • A track record of owning work end to end, from an ambiguous problem to a solution running in production. 
  • Experience working directly with customers, partners or business stakeholders and turning their needs into technical plans.
  • Strong C# and .NET (.NET 8+), ASP.NET Core APIs and microservices design; Clean Architecture, CQRS/MediatR and DDD fundamentals. 
  • Hands-on Kafka in production: partitioning, consumer groups, delivery semantics, idempotency, retries and DLQs, and the outbox pattern. 
  • Redis in production: cache-aside, TTL and invalidation, distributed locks and rate limiting, with awareness of consistency trade-offs. 
  • Solid relational modelling and SQL (PostgreSQL or SQL Server), with Dapper or EF Core and query performance tuning. 
  • Production front-end experience with a modern framework (Vue/Nuxt, React or Angular) and TypeScript. 
  • Integration experience: REST and webhook design, OAuth2/OIDC, API versioning, and third-party systems such as ERP, payments or delivery platforms. 
  • Comfort with Docker, Kubernetes basics, CI/CD and observability tools such as Datadog. 
  • A product mindset: you start from the customer's outcome, push back when a request is not the real problem, and measure whether what you shipped is used. Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to present to an engineering team and a restaurant group's executives on the same day.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in restaurant tech, retail, POS, payments, loyalty or delivery aggregator integrations. 
  • A previous role as a Forward Deployed, Solutions, Integration or Customer Engineer at a product company. 
  • Building with LLMs and AI agents in production (prompting, tool use, evaluations), applied to customer workflows. 
  • Mobile exposure (Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin, Flutter or React Native), or experience with super-app and mini-app models.

The Job in a Nutshell 💡

In this role, you will play a key part in identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating organizational risks while ensuring business resilience and operational continuity. You will work closely with various business units, IT, Information Security, and other stakeholders to strengthen the organization's risk management practices, enhance its ability to respond to disruptions, and ensure alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry best practices, including SAMA regulations.

You will contribute to risk assessments, Business Impact Analysis (BIA), business continuity planning, disaster recovery testing, regulatory compliance, and risk reporting, helping ensure that Foodics maintains a proactive and resilient approach to managing risks and business disruptions.

What Will You Do? ❓

1. Risk Management & Assessment

  • Maintain and regularly update the enterprise risk register, ensuring risks, controls, and mitigation plans are properly documented.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of existing controls and recommend improvements to address identified risks.
  • Support the development and monitoring of risk mitigation strategies and action plans.
  • Participate in stress testing and scenario analysis to assess potential business exposures.

2. Business Continuity Management (BCM)

  • Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of the Business Continuity Management (BCM) framework.
  • Coordinate and assist in conducting Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and Business Continuity Risk Assessments across business functions.
  • Support the development, review, and maintenance of Business Continuity Plans (BCPs) and recovery strategies.
  • Coordinate BCM tests, exercises, and simulations to assess organizational readiness.
  • Monitor BCM action plans and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely implementation and closure.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business resilience and minimize the impact of potential disruptions.

3. IT Disaster Recovery (DR) & Resilience

  • Support the development, maintenance, and implementation of IT Disaster Recovery plans and procedures.
  • Coordinate DR planning, testing, and execution in collaboration with IT, infrastructure, and technology teams.
  • Ensure recovery strategies and procedures are aligned with business recovery requirements, including Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
  • Participate in disaster recovery exercises and support post-test reviews, documenting findings and improvement actions.
  • Monitor DR readiness and follow up on identified gaps to strengthen IT resilience.

4. Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Support the interpretation and implementation of applicable regulatory requirements, particularly SAMA regulations related to risk management, business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
  • Assist in developing and updating risk, BCM, and DR policies, procedures, and frameworks in line with regulatory expectations and industry best practices.
  • Support regulatory reporting requirements and coordinate responses to regulatory inquiries and assessments.
  • Assist in internal and external audits, regulatory examinations, and compliance reviews.
  • Track audit findings, regulatory observations, and remediation plans to ensure timely closure.

5. Monitoring, Reporting & Stakeholder Management

  • Prepare periodic risk, BCM, and DR reports, dashboards, and key risk indicators (KRIs) for management review.
  • Monitor risk exposures, control effectiveness, BCM readiness, and DR performance.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of risk assessments, business continuity plans, recovery procedures, incidents, and mitigation activities.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to promote awareness and ensure effective implementation of risk and resilience requirements.
  • Support the development and delivery of risk management, business continuity, and regulatory awareness sessions.

Familiarity with regulatory requirements, particularly SAMA regulations related to risk management, BCM, DR, and operational resilience.

Understanding of Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).

Strong analytical, organizational, and project coordination skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint) and G-Suite.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Good command of English (Arabic is a strong advantage).

    BCM and IT/DR domains.
